about.text: The smaller of the two big whey proteins (14.2 kDa, about 20 % of whey protein in cow milk), made into enriched ingredients for infant formula, where it brings the protein closer to human milk.

links.name: Romo et al., Foods 2023: Separation of alpha-Lactalbumin Enriched Fraction from Bovine Native Whey Concentrate

facts.v: Selective precipitation 52-83 %; chelating agents about 90 %; with centrifugation after precipitation 99.4 %
Ultrafiltration plus 600 MPa for 4 min at 23 °C and pH 4.6: 46 % yield, 80 % purity
Calcium-binding ion exchange resin destabilises alpha-lac, pH and temperature then precipitate it, beta-lg stays in solution (de Wit, US 5420249 as described in a later patent)
